goals: Fix the self-host execution-isolation defect where a worker attempt wrote into the main checkout instead of its task worktree, producing a workspace-boundary violation (observed run 4809f45a: src/execution/*.ts, tests/execution-interface.test.ts and dist/execution/* appeared in the repository root during attempt 0). Enforce three invariants with fail-fast guards: (1) the worker spawn cwd and the verifier cwd must be the absolute task worktree path, never the repository root; abort before spawn when cwd is missing, non-absolute, or resolves to the repository root, with a clear worker-cwd-guard error; (2) the WorkspaceBoundary authority snapshot for a task must target the task worktree, not the repository root; (3) add 'dist' to DEFAULT_EXCLUDED_CONTROL_PATHS so npm run build output is never reported as a protected-root change. Add regression tests proving a repository-root cwd aborts before any write, the boundary captures and compares the task worktree, and a newly added dist/ file does not trigger a violation. Preserve exact-identity process safety, write-path auditing and the .git selective re-inclusion. Do not add launchd, Windows or sandbox backends.
nonGoals: Do not weaken exact-identity or write-path auditing.
Do not change TaskContract or EvidenceBundle semantics.
Do not add launchd, Windows or sandbox backends.
deliverables: Fail-fast worker and verifier cwd guards.
WorkspaceBoundary authority aligned to the task worktree.
dist excluded and cwd-guard regression tests.
forbidden: Do not let a repository-root cwd reach spawn.
Do not weaken write-path or process-identity safety.
Do not add launchd, Windows or sandbox backends.
